scope: Read-only review of EXP-028 hooks for a new real EXP-029 capture; not launch approval or model execution proof

findings.title: The unmodified real comp loader ignores a custom evaluation directory
findings.trigger: Point only main --data or NTL_DATA at the 729-row blinded panel with SMOKE disabled.
findings.effect: Comp still reads competition train/test. Main and comp rows differ; comp loading may be caught and skipped, and the two caches cannot pass identity validation.
findings.required_action: The new EXP-029 runner must bind both real loaders to the same effective panel and original official train, without enabling SMOKE. Keep the EXP-028 sources frozen and document the new adapter's exact delta.
findings.classification: Launch wiring blocker; not a defect in observer-only instrumentation.

findings.title: The historical notebook does not provide a checked real-capture launcher
findings.trigger: Reuse the notebook's FAST_COMMIT branch or its '!python comp_stack.py ... | grep ...' command as the capture controller.
findings.effect: The public three-row file enables a constant placeholder instead of model execution. The shell pipeline also does not make comp process success a required precondition for main, allowing an expensive main run after comp failure or against a stale raw comp file.
findings.required_action: Use an explicit new real-capture entrypoint, checked child exit codes, isolated output paths, and the current comp commit receipt before starting main. Install generated files after all historical writefile cells.

findings.title: The default required-events template discards an otherwise inspectable cache when ATLAS raises before returning
findings.trigger: ATLAS raises before its return event, including a zero-row request; the original algorithm catches Exception and completes remaining postprocessing.
findings.effect: The template requires atlas_returned, so component_end raises CaptureFailure and no COMMITTED main cache is produced. This fails closed, but differs from the replay layer's intended nonempty partial-coverage result. For an empty request, the current replayer additionally rejects an absent return even though no scores are needed.
findings.required_action: Choose the real run's event policy before launch. If partial diagnostic caches should commit, handle missing/nonempty ATLAS returns in a new EXP-029 adapter or copied validator and keep accepted=false/needs-additional. Preserve zero-row empty returns explicitly; do not invent scores or silently relax the frozen EXP-028 helper.
findings.classification: Conditional capture policy gap; fail-closed behavior is safe.

hook_assessment.first_data_event: Observer initialization occurs after both scripts have finalized test text and IDs, before model work. It automatically emits data with ID order, fixed labels and exact text fingerprints.
hook_assessment.main: main_svc4_margin precedes weighted LP; main_members snapshots ordered LP and train targets; comp load/status, pre-ATLAS, request/return, Sinkhorn and typography boundaries have source anchors.
hook_assessment.comp: Only the two evaluation svc_probs calls use the wrapped style margin. The tiny training self-test calls decision_function directly, so it does not create a misleading evaluation event. Family scores are captured before and after actual gates.
hook_assessment.failure_semantics: Array/JSON capture errors become SystemExit-derived CaptureFailure and are not swallowed by original optional-model except Exception blocks. An invalid from_env context fails before model work.
hook_assessment.context_validation: The observer checks scope/run_id/required_events and launch_ready for real scopes. It does not itself validate all checkpoint hashes, environment, budgets or expected inventories; the new real runner must do so before model launch.
hook_assessment.output_integrity: Component directories are exclusive, arrays are copied without dtype conversion, text inputs are fingerprints only, and external manifest hashes are printed at commit. COMMITTED still proves component bytes only.
hook_assessment.package: The seven packaged files match their EXP-028 package-manifest hashes. New runner must make observer/cache/gauss modules importable beside each child script.

inventories.source_derivation: Derived from the original model-spec and add_member branches, not copied from synthetic fixture success.
inventories.main_conditions: For the frozen six MODELS, svc_w=1.5, distort_w=.10, adapt_w=1.0. Gaussian keys remain present as zero arrays when no main Gte group has size 2..18; twin keys also remain present and are zero on singletons. TF-IDF retains a zero fallback key after a caught fit exception.
inventories.comp_group_condition: The following nine contributions appear only if comp GROUP_ROWS.any(), derived from G_TE group size 2..18. This is a different grouping from main Gte and Stylegram G_style.

comp_optional_token_attention.condition: tokattn_debl23_final.pt AND deberta-v3-large backbone are attached

excluded: tokattn_q35 is unavailable for this proposed capture and must be explicitly excluded before launch, not discovered missing after acceptance.
inventories.maximum_condition: All four optional LoRA checkpoints and Deb token head attached; at least one eligible comp group. No source basis for a fixed count of 24.
inventories.group_policy: Freeze attachment-derived optional presence and the conditional grouping rule before inference. Do not freeze synthetic 23 or unconditionally demand group heads on an all-singleton panel. Any resolved inventory must prove the predeclared G_TE condition rather than deleting missing members retrospectively.

family_gates.conditional: claude requires API passage attachment; claude_lora requires the matching LoRA head fields. Gate events are not add_member inventory entries.

panel_and_io_requirements: Use the new blinded 729-row test CSV with only id/text; keep true model and prompt sidecar local and out of the uploaded payload.
Bind both child readers to the same test bytes and original official training bytes. A metadata label alone does not redirect comp's hardcoded real loader.
Clear NTL_SMOKE/NTL_FAKE_TEST and main --sim/--fake_test overrides. Set NTL_DROP_Q35 consistently with the frozen exclusion.

Preserve string IDs through the original pandas readers: prefixed blind IDs avoid numeric or leading-zero coercion. Validate the effective read-back text strings, since default NA parsing can differ from verify_cache keep_default_na=False.
Do not place the evaluation CSV under names matched by comp's public-training glob patterns; a plain test.csv is not one of those training patterns.
Keep expected_main_members/expected_comp_members or a predeclared conditional inventory policy in the same context used by both components; verify the context hash and external commit receipts.
Require a real Parquet engine in the target runtime before heavy work. The EXP-028 parity harness deliberately intercepted to_parquet and did not validate the engine.
Use fresh run outputs and capture root; gate main on successful comp exit and this run's comp commit. Avoid reusing an old /kaggle/working/comp_logit.npy.

environment_assessment.python313_torch211: The official PyTorch compatibility matrix includes Python 3.13 for PyTorch 2.11. This is pair-level support, not proof of this exact Kaggle image or third-party extension compatibility.
additional_requirements: ATLAS bundle Python packages and their local config/tokenizer/adapter files
Optional bitsandbytes wheel must match the target Python/CUDA ABI if installed; never blindly install every discovered wheel
A pinned image or recorded installed versions including CUDA runtime/driver must accompany the run
The source's peft.import_utils torchao workaround and Transformers dtype/from_pretrained APIs must be import-tested in that environment
environment_assessment.torch_load: Original main heads.pt and comp token-attention torch.load calls omit weights_only. PyTorch 2.11 defaults to weights_only=True. Tensor/plain-container checkpoints can work; any unsupported pickled globals must be identified from the actual pinned checkpoints before launch. No blanket weights_only=False change is recommended.

official_sources.title: PyTorch release compatibility matrix
official_sources.claim_used: PyTorch 2.11 supports Python >=3.10 through 3.14; Python 3.13 lies in that range. CUDA wheel variants are version-specific.

official_sources.title: PyTorch 2.11 torch.load
official_sources.claim_used: weights_only defaults to True; supported checkpoint object types are restricted.

official_sources.title: Transformers installation
official_sources.claim_used: The library requires compatible PyTorch/Python and locally cached files for offline operation; current general documentation is not a pin for this experiment.
